notes: S2 (§14.5 steps (4) and (5)): the note's first entry fails the equation and its second entry names a key that nothing declares. Key resolution (step (4)) covers every entry before any equation (step (5)) decides the record, so the record is unverifiable E_KEY_UNKNOWN, not invalid E_SIG_INVALID; every entry still reports its state (invalid, unverified).
